verdict.rationale: Terraform is a CLI-first tool built for unattended runs. `-auto-approve` skips the interactive approval prompt, and `-json` emits machine-readable output, including a line-delimited JSON stream for plan, apply, refresh and test. Plans can be saved with `-out` and applied later, and inputs can be set with `-var`/`-var-file`, so pipelines run non-interactively. A community user also reports rebuilding whole environments automatically. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party guide to running Terraform in CI, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI pipeline usage specifically.
